candidates.change_summary: Remove the increment of proposalCount so it no longer increases on each new grant proposal.
Change the increment from += 1 to += 2 so proposalCount grows by two per proposal.
Replace the increment with a reset of proposalCount to 1 so it no longer accumulates across proposals.
Remove the assignment `VADER = _vader;` so VADER remains address(0) after init.
Assign the USDV address to VADER instead of the vader address.
Assign the vault address to VADER instead of the vader address.
Set VADER to address(0) instead of the vader address.
Set USDV to the _vader argument instead of _usdv.
Set USDV to the _vault argument instead of _usdv.
Remove the assignment that sets USDV to _usdv, leaving USDV at zero.
Replace the USDV assignment with an extra write to VADER using _usdv, leaving USDV at zero.
Assign address(0) to VAULT instead of _vault.
Delete the VAULT assignment so VAULT stays zero.
